steps: Rinse the toor dal well and pressure cook it with about 150 ml water a person and the turmeric for 3 to 4 whistles on medium.
Let the pressure drop on its own; the dal should be very soft. Whisk it lightly.
Heat the oil in a pan on medium, let half the cumin sizzle, then fry the onion, ginger, half the garlic and green chilli until light golden.
Add the tomato, most of the chilli powder, the coriander powder and salt and cook on medium for 3 to 4 minutes, until the tomato is soft.
Stir in the dal and simmer on low for 5 to 7 minutes, adding hot water if it gets too thick.
Stir in the garam masala, crushed kasuri methi and coriander leaves, then turn off the heat.
For the tadka, heat the ghee on medium and fry the bay leaf, the rest of the cumin and garlic until the garlic is pale gold.
Take it off the heat, stir in the hing and the last pinch of chilli powder, and pour it over the dal straight away.
note: The tadka is now in ghee, as all three sources do. Cream is gone because none of the sources use it.
